source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Select "Hardware status" > Click tab "Inventory and LEDs" then check the Fans information and detail information

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Data should be readable and correct.
2. Check the every fans status is fit actual status
3. Check Fan speed is correct.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: curl -s -k -u "$BMC_USER:$BMC_PASS" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -X GET https://$BMC_IP/redfish/v1/Chassis/FRU_SYS/Thermal | jq .Fans | range(0;8) as $i | .Fans[$i] | select(.Name|test("SPD_FAN";"i"))
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL pretty-printed JSON from /redfish/v1/Chassis/FRU_SYS/Thermal (front fan SPD_*_F readings) so user can read/diff against SPEC for "SPD_FAN1_F~SPD_FAN16_F". No RISK (read-only).

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES is internally insufficient: title requires sixteen `_F` channels but range(0;8) examines at most eight and its jq pipeline/path do not prove the intended front/rotor mapping, units or thresholds.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED requires all sixteen mapped records, speed/status/threshold/freshness evidence and a no-control/no-fault boundary.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 969/2291 accepts the eight-entry command despite the sixteen-channel title.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: The next `_R` family is separate rear-side/rotor coverage; earlier speed-channel cases show suffix semantics must come from the fan/controller specification.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 preserves the `_F` identity; ED-34 allows approved telemetry tools; ED-35 forbids reducing sixteen channels or adding fan stimulus; ED-36 treats topology/ranges as readiness.

original_test_intent: Verify SPD_FAN1_F through SPD_FAN16_F are all represented, readable, physically/status-correct and reporting correct speed in BMC WebUI.
original_method: Enumerate the complete fan collection, resolve every `_F` tach/status channel through the approved fan/rotor topology, collect unit-aware RPM, presence, health, thresholds and freshness, and correlate with WebUI and safe observation without changing fan control.
manual_activity: The owner defines `_F`, maps all sixteen channels to physical fans/rotors and approves normal ranges. The agent may read telemetry; operator provides non-invasive physical/UI correlation and engineer decides acceptance.
safety_requirements: Do not change PWM/thresholds, disconnect/reseat fans, inject faults, power-cycle or reset.
Do not truncate sixteen channels to range(0;8).
Use trusted transport and protected credentials.
Do not infer airflow/cooling margin from RPM alone.
Stop on missing/duplicate mapping or stale/unparseable speed without automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Enumerate the complete Thermal/Fans collection and pages.
Resolve all sixteen `_F` channels to approved physical positions/rotors.
Collect redacted ID, location, presence, status, health, RPM/unit, PWM, thresholds and timestamps.
Compare to ranges and correlate WebUI plus safe physical observation.
Return evidence only with controls unchanged.
engineer_actions: Approve speed, threshold and health rules.
Review mismatches and issue formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Fails stated coverage because it limits indexing to eight, assumes a path and relies on name matching without exact physical mapping, units, thresholds or freshness.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Traverse the complete collection and explicitly account for SPD_FAN1_F through SPD_FAN16_F using the vendor map; preserve structured numeric/unit data.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All sixteen `_F` names, WebUI fan detail, three Criteria and original time values remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform complete sixteen-channel, unit-aware telemetry reconciliation under a no-control/no-stimulus boundary.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC, thermal schema and parser versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor cooling topology/controller specification and Project thermal limits.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact channel coverage, topology, thresholds, freshness and safe physical correlation while retaining WebUI inspection.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Eight entries, RPM alone or healthy status alone cannot satisfy all sixteen physical/status/speed checkpoints or prove airflow.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Sixteen-channel map, suffix meaning and acceptable telemetry ranges.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Name order may not match physical order; fan-control or fault actions could cause overheating and remain excluded.

project_override_considerations: Alternate telemetry collectors require exact sixteen-channel identity, unit/range/freshness equivalence and engineer approval; uncovered WebUI or physical-status coverage must be recorded.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title and Criteria consistently require sixteen fan channels; the eight-entry command is an incomplete review-layer implementation, not an alternate authoritative scope.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The sixteen-fan purpose is clear; suffix mapping, exact population and expected ranges are Project readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Corrects half-coverage, assumed ordering and missing unit/topology/threshold controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Independently agrees with hybrid classification, complete collection and no-stimulus boundary.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Rejects direct-run acceptance of an eight-entry command for a sixteen-entry testcase.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Keeps `_F` coverage separate from `_R` and earlier fan-channel variants.

review_improvement: Exposes the explicit 16-versus-8 coverage defect and requires every fan channel to be tied to a physical position and valid speed context.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source command cannot satisfy its own title because range(0;8) caps inspection at eight. Fan names and array order are not reliable physical topology; correctness needs all sixteen mapped channels, unit-aware time-stamped RPM/state evidence and non-invasive observation, while control or disconnect testing is separate high-risk coverage.
